GoT.corner_interpretation: Changing upper-left patch remains a clue, not proof that missing world geometry is compressed there. Small render-pass records mostly describe 32x32 atlas tiles in 2048x2048 surfaces. The top-right FPS overlay is separate.

upstream_rebase: Already up to date before changes; resolved twice during preparation.
preserved_fixes: All ancestors of PR192 retained, including buffer fault handoff, stencil ownership, image subresource mapping, CPU/SRT/descriptor fixes and native memory/termination guards. No rollback or game/shader/vendor exception.
source_corrections: Preserve non-constant sample offsets when enabled maintenance8, shaderImageGatherExtended and min/max texel offset cover signed six-bit GCN offsets.
Emit ImageGatherExtended capability; keep constant offsets, explicit LOD, derivatives and coordinate handling. Unsupported hosts retain the existing warning/limitation.
Increment compiled shader binary version 32 to 33; old dropped-offset shaders cannot be reused.
Refresh semaphore completion after timeout before reporting the first wait; old values could misidentify the stalled submission.

diagnostics.activation: SHADPS4_GPU_PROGRESS=1, graphics diagnostics on, performance profiling off; host query reset and timestamp-capable graphics queue required.
diagnostics.markers: ALL_COMMANDS timestamps before recorded GPU work and at session ends, including ordered-GDS dispatch. Shader/texture metadata records do not get timestamps.
diagnostics.interpretation: before-completed-seq is the greatest available before-command marker; first-unavailable-seq is the next unavailable marker after it. The command at the completed marker can still be the stalled command. Sequence range can contain multiple commands; timestamps perturb scheduling and do not prove a shader is faulty.
diagnostics.bounds: Eight pools of 4096 queries; only completed pools from earlier submission ticks can be reset. If full, skip markers and report count; never skip guest work. Query results use availability without WAIT.
diagnostics.shader_capture: Prefer shaders bound around observed GPU progress range, then validation/sample-offset shaders, before legacy provenance/first-wait lists. Preserve capped evidence limits.
diagnostics.fps: Diagnostic mode perturbs GPU scheduling; do not use it as a performance benchmark.

validation.pinned_build_environment: GCC14, CMake4.4.4, Ninja1.13.2, rootless local dependencies including libuuid; no source dependency changes.
validation.openorbis_probe: Original runtime IMAGE_SAMPLE_L_O homebrew, seven offset cases including signed six-bit extrema. Strict C11 syntax and actual emulator GCN/SPIR-V translation pass. SDK link and physical PS4 execution NOT RUN.
validation.sanitizer_limit: ASan/UBSan pass; LeakSanitizer unavailable under this host ptrace, detect_leaks=0.
